answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university, which includes the senate.
Office holders of higher rank are involved wherever the university-wide plan and funding are affected.
Appointments are part of the university-wide plan, involving office holders of higher rank.
The president leads the university as a whole rather than an individual faculty council.
Study programmes are treated as part of the university-wide plan involving higher office holders.
Examination matters are part of the university-wide plan involving higher office holders.
Faculty internal research funding is handled at the faculty level rather than by the university president.
Module revision is an operational degree programme matter delegated to lower levels.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a specific faculty-level operational task.
Orientation week planning is an operational student activity outside the central leadership scope.
